chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The first one to take to the sandals was Ibrahim (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: Who was the first person to wear sandals according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Kafi attributes the invention of sandals to Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him), establishing a prophetic precedent for this specific type of footwear. In Shia jurisprudence, this narrative supports the permissibility of wearing leather sandals and informs the etiquette (adab) of dress, linking practical daily habits to the legacy of the patriarchs.
